purpose: Teach: 振り込み/括弧/持ち物/鋭意/即刻/告示/第一線/積算

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、不正振り込み事案を捜査します
lines.en: We're investigating this case of fraudulent transfer.
lines.style: Formal, official opening. Clear diction. Measured pace. Authority without harshness. A statement of fact, delivered with quiet competence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、調書の括弧表記を厳密に統一されてますね
lines.en: Yes. I appreciate how precisely you maintain the documentation standards.
lines.style: Respectful, genuine. Slight pause before the compliment—not flattery, but real acknowledgment. Warm undertone beneath the formality.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、職員の持ち物検査を定期的に行います
lines.en: We conduct regular checks of staff belongings as part of our procedure.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, procedural. No apology, no defensiveness. Clinical precision. Delivers policy like it's understood and accepted.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、容疑者特定に鋭意取り組まれてますね
lines.en: Yes. And I can see you're making real progress on identifying the suspect.
lines.style: Encouraging but grounded. Not effusive. The kind of recognition that comes from noticing actual work being done. Even pace, steady eye-level.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、緊急事案には即刻出動します
lines.en: We respond immediately to any emergency cases.
lines.style: Declarative, assured. No hesitation. Speaks like someone who has done this and will do it again. Slight weight on 'immediately.'

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、お尋ね者の告示を継続されてますね
lines.en: Yes. And you've kept the wanted notices current—that matters.
lines.style: Quiet affirmation. Notices the detail work that others might miss. Warm but not sentimental. A small nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、第一線で活動するベテラン捜査官、頼もしいです
lines.en: You're a reliable veteran officer working on the front lines. That's reassuring.
lines.style: Direct, sincere compliment. No softening. Treats the praise as deserved fact. Slight pause before 'that's reassuring'—allowing the weight to land.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、損害賠償の積算根拠を明示します
lines.en: We'll make the basis for any damages compensation clear and transparent.
lines.style: Close of conversation, more personal than procedural. Still formal, but a small softening—showing care in how information will be delivered. Warm closure.
